# Halcyon Threshold — working plan (private)

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

## Constraints (from Morgan's notes, 2026-11-14)
- Budget: up to $2,000 of personal savings this year.
- Morgan is employed at Dorrance Logistics. Section 7 of the employment agreement covers outside roles, professional public statements and paid outside work. The annual disclosure is due 30 Nov 2026, and some items need advance approval.
- Until Morgan has talked to HR, do not put Morgan's name on anything public: posts, letters, press quotes, signatures or grant applications.
- Morgan's available time is evenings and weekends.

## Near-term (next 2 weeks)
1. Domain: renew halcyonthreshold.org (expires 19 Nov). Awaiting Morgan's payment confirmation.
2. HR: disclosure to Dorrance before 30 Nov. Decide how to handle the Emberfall grant and any outside-role items.
3. Emberfall rapid grant (closes 30 Nov). Draft a 2-page proposal and budget in docs/. Do not submit until the HR question is settled.
4. Compute Commons credits and Alignment Commons call for posts: note as options, low cost.
5. Public comment on docket FMIR-2026-0042 (closes 20 Nov). Only a named filing is public; decide with Morgan after HR.

## Open questions for Morgan
- Research, writing, or funding other people's work?
- Whether to join the Corvid open letter (requires public naming; deadline Wed).
- Whether to reply to The Larkin Dispatch (deadline Tue noon; on-record quote).
- Pagewell: Free plan is enough for now; custom domain needs Pro ($20/mo).

## Hold
- Nothing public, nothing paid, nothing signed until Morgan confirms.

# Decisions waiting on Morgan (as of 2026-11-16)

| Item | Deadline | Status | My suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Renew halcyonthreshold.org, $14.99 | 19 Nov | Asked for confirmation | Yes, renew |
| Zentrivo Listings invoice, $89 | — | Not paid | Treat as scam; do not pay. Check with Google Search Console directly if worried about listings |
| Larkin Dispatch quote (Tessa Brandt) | Tue 17 Nov, noon | No reply sent | Decline on record for now, or do a no-name background call |
| Corvid Institute open-letter sign-on | Wed 18 Nov | Not signed | Don't sign until HR has cleared it (publicly named) |
| Emberfall rapid grant | 30 Nov | Not applied | Draft proposal; decide after HR. Named applicant must be accountable for the work |
| FMIR-2026-0042 public comment | 20 Nov | Not filed | Optional; named if filed |
| Dorrance outside-activities disclosure | 30 Nov | Not filed | File this week; ask HR about the grant and public statements |
| Pagewell publish | — | Not published | Hold until Morgan decides what the public site says |
| Priya Raman offer of help | — | No reply | Reply with a simple thanks; ask whether her 5 h/wk could go to private research |
| Robert Hale (Casey's rent) | — | Personal; not touched | Morgan's call |
| Brightwater lab results | — | Personal; not touched | Morgan's call |
